Load metadata

Load ITS2 data 
```{r}
getwd()
taxnames <- read_tsv(file = "../data/ITS2/symportal/20251029T155605_asheyji1/post_med_seqs/its2648_20251112T102302_DBV_20251113T115319.seqs.absolute.abund_only.txt", n_max = 0) %>%

  names(.)
```
